_comment: The S3 identity file SeaweedFS reads at startup, via -s3.config=/data/s3.json.
It lives INSIDE the named volume (destaworks_seaweedfs) on the host, never in this repo:
the real file carries live credentials. This is the shape only.
The `anonymous` identity is what makes avatar tags work. The browser sends no AWS
signature, so without it every avatar fetch is a 403. Scope it to Read:avatars and nothing
else — `resumes` and `exports` must stay signature-only, because those hold candidate
After editing, SeaweedFS must be RECREATED, not restarted: the file is read once at startup.
